description: Implementation of a Windows-specific video decoder using Media Foundation and DirectX, supporting hardware-accelerated VP9, H264, and AV1 decoding, with management of decode targets and threading.

classes.name: VideoFrame
classes.description: Represents a video frame, including timestamp and release callback.

classes.name: VideoFrameImpl
classes.description: Implementation of VideoFrame that calls a release callback upon destruction.

classes.name: VideoDecoder
classes.description: Handles hardware-accelerated video decoding on Windows using Media Foundation and DirectX, supporting VP9, H264, and AV1 codecs, with threading and decode target management.

methods.name: CreateVideoTransform
methods.description: Creates and configures a MediaTransform for video decoding with specified GUIDs and device manager.

methods.name: InitializeCodec
methods.description: Initializes the decoder with the appropriate MediaTransform based on codec type.

methods.name: ShutdownCodec
methods.description: Releases decoder resources and resets state.

methods.name: EnsureDecoderThreadRunning
methods.description: Starts the decoder thread if not already running.

methods.name: UpdateVideoArea
methods.description: Updates the video display area based on media type attributes.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame from an IMFSample, associating timestamp and sample data.

methods.name: DeleteVideoFrame
methods.description: Removes a VideoFrame from internal tracking.

methods.name: DecoderThreadRun
methods.description: Main loop for decoding, processing input/output, handling events, and errors.

methods.name: ReleaseDecodeTargets
methods.description: Releases cached decode targets during shutdown.
